answer.text: I can't give you AU-EAST's revenue for last quarter. Your role only has access to NZ-SOUTH, and the database filters out rows from other regions. The empty result for AU-EAST means the data is hidden from you, not that revenue was zero. I can show you NZ-SOUTH revenue for the same period if that helps.
assumptions: Revenue is net sales in NZD after discounts, net of returns
Region access is limited to NZ-SOUTH by row-level filtering

sql.sql:
select sum(s.net_amount_nzd) as revenue
from marts.fct_sales as s
where s.order_date between %(start_date)s and %(end_date)s and s.region = any(%(filter_0)s)
limit %(row_limit)s
